pr_title: sensors: Fix shell missing channel types
pr_body:
The shell tries to decode all channel types and sequential channel indexes. Unfortunately when swapping to channel specs we forgot to reset the channel index for the next channel type to look at.

Fixes #73296
pr_comments:
Does it work on https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/72972/commits/862833b38f1a6718e8dbb0d0f68ab50364b859d1 (#72972)?

Specifically, update the pytest to check if every channel has an output:

```python
def assert_lines_has(lines, expected):
    assert any([expected in line for line in lines]), 'expected response not found'

for channel in range(59):
    logger.info(f'channel {channel}')
    lines = shell.exec_command(f'sensor get sensor@0 {channel}')
    assert_lines_has(lines, f'channel type={channel}')
```

I linked #72840 to this PR as well.

Edit:
This probably doesn't fix #73296 completely, as the said gyro is still not dt configurable after this PR
And right, shouldn’t have this issue with metadata about what channels a sensor has available (we don’t have this today)

issue_context.title: ICM42688 is not configurable from DTS and gyro does not work with sensor shell
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**


Please also mention any information which could help others to understand
the problem you're facing:
 - Using platform VMU_RT1170
 - Unable to set params for ICM42688 from dts (just overrides with fixed values at lowest settings that clip in most use cases): https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/68bd4da4c64ca0c19cee0334bee6496ec8cde2b9/drivers/sensor/tdk/icm42688/icm42688.c#L274-L286

Also sensor shell does not work properly for gyro:
![Screenshot_from_2024-05-25_11-50-17](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/assets/10233412/b8918323-98a6-42a5-b0b5-4fe6f667b2e0)


**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Attempt to set sensor attributes with DTS for ICM42688
2. Test shaking and see it locks to 125 deg/sec (hard coded gyro FS)
3. Run sensor shell and see it does not output gyro 

**Expected behavior**
Sensor should be configurable and sensor shell should work for the gyro.

**Impact**
Makes sensor not work as expected.
comments: @yperess @teburd this might interest you on the sensor shell issue.
Thanks for the report, I’ll try and take a look next week

The shell issue seems tied to the way the sensor_shell currently works, and @ycsin noted issues as well in #72841 and related PRs/issues. I'm looking at this, and it is a bug but I don't think its solely tied to this driver. Notably if I force using the fetch + channel_get API with some Kconfig hacks the gyro works mostly fine
